Method of Attack: Masquerades as legitimate SuperAntiSpyware anti-malware program to trick users into installing ransomware
Encrypts files with specific extensions and renames them with -Lock.onion extension
Deletes shadow volume copies and Windows backups
Downloads and executes SDelete to overwrite free disk space
Checks victim's country and language to avoid encrypting certain regions
Creates ransom notes with victim key and ransom instructions
Indicators of Compromise: Associated files: C:\ProgramData\Safe.exe, C:\ProgramData\EventLog.txt, # How to Decrypt Files.html
Malicious executable name: SUPERAntiSpywares.exe (note the added 's')
Ransom note file: # How to Decrypt Files.html
